ghosts.souvenir.none: every dot is still sitting there, and the ghosts are still going round and round.
ghosts.souvenir.some: you went round the maze eating up dots with the ghosts on your tail.
ghosts.souvenir.big: you ate one of the big dots and the ghosts went pale and turned tail.
ghosts.souvenir.chased: you ate a big dot, and then you ate a ghost. it went home to have a think about it.
ghosts.souvenir.clear: not one dot left anywhere in the maze. the whole board, cleared out.
